Hi, this Wednesday (2024-04-10T13:00:00-04:00), @Adam Topaz will have a talk in our Rutgers Lean seminar. It's the same Zoom link as before, feel free to DM me if you don't have it.

Title: A tour of sheaf theory in mathlib

Abstract: This talk will give an overview of sheaf theory as it appears in mathlib. While there is currently essentially a single way to construct a "category of sheaves", in practice, there are several ways to construct Grothendieck topologies, and to prove the sheaf condition itself. I'll highlight some of these general constructions during the talk. I will also discuss the existing applications of this part of the library, as well as some work in progress related to this in the context of algebraic geometry.
